memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Vitamin B12 deficiency
- Status: Newly diagnosed, symptomatic with mild fatigue and occasional paresthesias.
- Plan: Start methylcobalamin 1.5 mg 1-0-0 after food; check weight and waist; advise diet: breakfast - include fortified cereals and dairy; lunch - leafy greens and legumes; dinner - lean meat or fish.
Weight 62 kg, waist 78 cm (below 80 cm cut‑off).
Due: none (no glucose‑lowering therapy).

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum vitamin B12: 150 pg/mL (ref 200‑900).\nMCV: 98 fL (ref 80‑100).\nHemoglobin: 12.2 g/dL (ref 12‑16).

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Vitamin B12 deficiency\n- Status: Ongoing treatment, fatigue improved, mild tingling persists.\n- Plan: Continue methylcobalamin 1.5 mg 1-0-0 after food; repeat B12 in 8 weeks; weight 61.8 kg, waist 77 cm; diet advice: breakfast - egg and whole‑grain toast; lunch - dal with vegetables; dinner - grilled chicken with salad.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum vitamin B12: 340 pg/mL (ref 200‑900).\nMCV: 92 fL (ref 80‑100).\nHemoglobin: 13.0 g/dL (ref 12‑16).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I still feel occasional numbness in my feet, especially after long walks. Wondering if I need a higher dose of B12.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Vitamin B12 deficiency\n- Status: Biochemical improvement but residual neuropathic symptoms.\n- Plan: Increase methylcobalamin to 2.0 mg 1-0-0 after food; advise foot care and gentle stretching; weight 62.1 kg, waist 78 cm; diet: breakfast - milk and oats; lunch - mixed veg curry with rice; dinner - fish curry.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum vitamin B12: 480 pg/mL (ref 200‑900).\nMCV: 90 fL (ref 80‑100).\nHemoglobin: 13.4 g/dL (ref 12‑16).

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Booked follow‑up appointment for 2025-11-05 at 10:30 am with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04).

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Vitamin B12 deficiency\n- Status: Asymptomatic, labs normal.\n- Plan: Maintain methylcobalamin 2.0 mg 1-0-0 after food; repeat B12 in 3 months; weight 62.0 kg, waist 78 cm; diet: breakfast - yogurt and fruit; lunch - chapati with lentil soup; dinner - stir‑fried tofu and vegetables.

memories.text: Vitamin B12 deficiency\n- Status: Stable on treatment, no symptoms.\n- Plan: Continue methylcobalamin 2.0 mg 1-0-0 after food; check B12 in 3 months; weight 62.3 kg, waist 79 cm (still <80 cm); diet: breakfast - idli with sambar; lunch - vegetable pulao with raita; dinner - grilled paneer with salad.
